episode.title: Synthetic Layout Canary — August 28
episode.subtitle: A non-factual fixture that exercises every reusable scene family

provenance.notice: Synthetic canary only; not a historical episode and not evidence of any event

scenes.title: A metric can become the visual subject
scenes.body: Placeholder copy exercises large numerals, a progress rail, and phone-safe supporting text.

scenes.title: Two declared values can share the frame
scenes.body: The fixture checks equal visual weight without implying that either placeholder describes the real world.

scenes.title: A timeline reveals steps in order
scenes.body: These labels test deterministic progressive disclosure. They are interface samples, not dated events.

scenes.title: A process can stay inside the square crop
scenes.body: Four compact stages exercise the busiest allowed layout while preserving caption and action safe zones.

scenes.title: A record can carry the evidence beat
scenes.body: The paper layout tests line density and checked states without presenting a real filing or quotation.

scenes.title: Quote styling does not make text a quote
scenes.body: This intentionally fictional line tests typography. The provenance banner prevents it from masquerading as evidence.

scenes.title: A semantic symbol can anchor a place beat
scenes.body: The generic icon is supplied by props and carries alt text, with no external asset or invented location.

scenes.title: The same engine reaches a deterministic close
scenes.body: Only props changed across this fixture. The component, timing contract, captions, and credits stayed fixed.

captions.text: This is a synthetic metric fixture.
The timeline labels are interface samples.
Four process steps stay inside the safe crop.
The document is not a real filing.
The styled words are not a real quotation.
The symbol carries accessible alt text.
Daily content belongs in data, not TSX.

credits.music: NO MUSIC — SYNTHETIC PARAMETRIC COMPOSITION FIXTURE
